name: Gaslight
description:
[Wiki Page](https://wiki.roll20.net/Script:Gaslight)

Per-player map perception. Split players onto individual copies of a page with tokens synchronized via Anchor. Each player can see different things (different token art, names, hidden tokens) while token movement stays consistent across all copies.

Use cases: illusions, shapechangers, stealth/perception, madness/hallucinations, secrets.

**v2.2.0 - New features:**
- Initiative HUD: pin-based turn tracker with gestures (swipe to advance/retreat, drag to reorder, delete to remove), customizable diamond highlight, current turn reticle, frame resize/move, proportional slot distribution
- `!gaslight init` command: sync/trim linked tokens in initiative
- HUD registry: unified enable/disable/reset for view, initiative, reticle elements
- `--default` flags: `stage --default on|off`, `sync --default`, `desync --default` for character-level config
- Asymmetric unlink/delete: parent tokens cascade, non-parent copies just detach
- Auto-add to initiative on stage: staging mid-combat adds linked copies to turn order
- ScriptKit integration: interactive guide examples, help system, annotations
- 5 guide-only examples: getting-started, core-mechanics, initiative-hud, relay, scripting
- Applied script fixes: compProp resolution fallback to character attributes, regex fix for [default] syntax

Commands:
- `!gaslight split <group>` -- Activate a gaslight group
- `!gaslight merge [group]` -- Tear down links, return players
- `!gaslight setup <group> [players...]` -- Quick setup from duplicate pages
- `!gaslight stage [--default on|off]` -- Propagate tokens to player pages
- `!gaslight link [name|new] [ids...]` -- Manually link tokens
- `!gaslight unlink [ids...|--group <g>]` -- Remove links (asymmetric)
- `!gaslight sync [--default] [props|all|reset]` -- Manage sync config
- `!gaslight desync [--default] [props|all]` -- Exclude props from sync
- `!gaslight view [master|off|<player>]` -- Control command relay targeting
- `!gaslight relay <views> <!command>` -- Relay command to specific views
- `!gaslight init [sync|trim]` -- Sync initiative with HUD
- `!gaslight hud [element] [on|off|reset]` -- Toggle HUD elements
- `!gaslight var [--silent] --set|--get|--del <name> [value]` -- Manage gl_* variables
- `!gaslight eval [--all] [--dry-run]` -- Evaluate GLS scripts
- `!gaslight config [relay-add|relay-remove|relay-list]` -- Configure relay
- `!gaslight status` -- Show current state
- `!gaslight --help` -- Command reference
